description: Return the weekly Taren Raider stream plan with each day’s game and the exact ISO-8601 instant of the next stream. Use this to answer when Taren streams next or what is planned for a given day. Optionally pass an IANA timezone to render every time in the caller’s zone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (for example "America/New_York" or "Europe/Berlin") used to render stream times.

name: get_schedule
title: Weekly schedule
